create_warmup_param_hook: create a WarmupParamHook instance to warmup a model parameter over specified epochs
use_get_param: use get_param to retrieve the current value of a warmup parameter from the model
use_set_param: use set_param to set a new value for a warmup parameter on the model
review_before_train: review the before_train hook method that captures the original parameter value before training starts
review_before_train_iter: review the before_train_iter hook method that computes and applies the warmup value each iteration
